  ],
  "strongest_group_differences": [
    "Combined paradigm has 14-fold more observations than Bright Visual Only, creating severe imbalance that affects comparative power",
    "Sham condition (n=3,505) is the smallest non-visual-only group, potentially limiting detection of true ICMS effects",

    "Time-to-Target extreme maximum (201.4s) likely driven by specific paradigms or failed trials, warranting outlier investigation by group",
    "Path Efficiency's enormous range (0.0009 to 29.8) indicates some paradigms may produce highly circuitous paths versus direct navigation"
  ],
  "practical_interpretation": "The Combined paradigm (ICMS + visual stimulation) appears to be the primary experimental condition, with single-modality conditions serving as controls. The severe sample imbalance favors detecting Combined effects while potentially underpowering comparisons among Dim Visual Only, Bright Visual Only, and Sham.   "recommended_next_analysis": "Compute paradigm-specific descriptive statistics (mean, SD, median, IQR) for all five response variables, then apply Welch's ANOVA or Kruskal-Wallis tests with Games-Howell or Dunn post-hoc comparisons to account for unequal variances and severe group imbalance. For Success (binary), use logistic regression with paradigm as predictor and mouse as random effect. Visualize distributions with violin plots stratified by paradigm to identify multimodality or outlier-driven effects. Finally, conduct sensitivity analyses excluding Time-to-Target >10s and Path Efficiency >5 to assess robustness of paradigm effects."
}
